part.text:
The robot reached the red wall at the end of the corridor and is now resting, as you asked.

It stopped about 0.5 m from the wall, judging by the side sonar (0.47 m). It is a bit closer than the 0.5 m you could have wanted to be, but the wall fills its camera view. I didn't measure the wall distance directly, so that figure is an estimate.

The route was: forward 3 m, a left turn, then several passages with turns to the right and left before reaching the red wall. The robot is now crouched with its motors off.
